findings.text: Saving was O(cross product) even with the cap (21.8 s for 65536x65536)
CG_CONS_DECL/DEF default-argument move breaks users with defaulted extra arguments
Current and new value value-initialized separately; a first write could be lost
Decimal values >= 2^63 rejected although documented up to 64 bits
Objections created before command-line init were not traced
Tree does not compile merged with PR #356
msvc16 project lacked the two new .cpp files
Empty or invalid component pattern threw std::regex_error and aborted
Empty +UVM_TESTNAME ran no test; a name matching a component segfaulted (null deref)
Heap-use-after-free when a parent is deleted before its child
+UVM_SEED applied in run_test, so components built in sc_main saw seed 1
Zombie request left in queue after its sequence restarted, read after delete
Request leaked when a waiting sequence is killed
Double delete when uvm_object_string_pool is copy-constructed
clone() refers to objects it does not own
uvm_pool<KEY,T> required operator<< for T
reset(false) let old waiters pass with new arrivals
Destructor after end of simulation threw E572 and terminated
Default REQ (uvm_sequence_item) did not compile
Test catcher was a local used after run_phase
wait_modified not woken by set(cntxt, relative inst)
Empty glob matched every scope on libstdc++
Test did not detect a revert of 1.2 on libstdc++
uvm_reg_mem_hdl_paths_seq read paths with uvm_hdl_data_t, rejecting objects the backdoor accepts
uvm_reg_access_seq errored on a register with a WO field (do_check substr)
Comparator dereferenced keys of deleted objects (crash / heap-use-after-free)
Fields with the same full name got order-dependent values
block.randomize dropped pending uvm_reg_fifo writes
32-bit seeds collided (22 pairs in 300k fields)
Register hooks ran in heap-address order
Seed frozen at first randomize
Built-in sequences overwrote a user seed
CRAVE register example failed its spread check for 2 of 61 seeds
flush() required a default-constructible T
Six test mutations survived

crave.note: suite_cost.py's CRAVE build failed once inside the CUDD sub-build (log truncated); the same commands rerun by hand in a fresh worktree built cleanly, and these numbers are from that run (configure not timed).

notes: UVM-SystemC, SystemC: main. FC4SC, CRAVE: development (main does not build: FC4SC main has no CMake build, CRAVE main does not find SystemC; the fork fixes are what make it build).

UVM-SystemC full ctest is dominated by one test: bugs/bug_184/basic_read_write_memory_management takes ~57 s; the other 73 tests take ~2.2 s summed in the serial run. The 6 failures are the known upstream macOS failures.
A first UVM-SystemC run measured the clean configure+build at 14.8 s; the rerun (recorded, with compile counts 74+95) took 51.8 s. Treat ~15-50 s as the range on this Mac.
CRAVE build includes fetching and building Z3 and CUDD; one CRAVE test fails on development (direct_Z3/Array/read_value_X).
